evals.prompt: Add an 'expenses' feature: record an expense, derive its posting, and list expenses for an org.
evals.expected_output: Pure posting logic in @saldo/domain with tests, a Zod contract, a loader/action boundary, Øre money, and accessible bilingual UI.
assertions: Pure posting/calculation logic lives in @saldo/domain with tests, not inline in the route
Input is validated with a Zod contract in app/contracts and types are inferred from it
The loader/action is the authoritative client↔server boundary; the client is trusted for nothing
Money values use the Øre type and addØre/subØre/mulRate — never number or float math
Figures use tabular-nums and user-facing copy is bilingual (NO/EN)

evals.prompt: Build a page to issue a credit note from an existing invoice.
evals.expected_output: An append-only issued document with gapless numbering and a recorded reviewer pass.
assertions: The issued document is append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE of posted rows); correction is via kreditnota
Credit-note numbering is gapless via the per-org counter, not a SEQUENCE
Per-line MVA is validated server-side via the domain checkVatLine, not only on the client
A reviewer subagent is run and recorded with a Reviewed-by trailer where review:check requires it
